sql.ricochetWebhook.getContactIdByRicochetLe: with existing_contact as ( select contact_id id from flow.contact_custom_field_value where text_value = :ricochetLeadId and archived is false limit 1 ) select (case when (select id from existing_contact) is not null then (select id::text from existing_contact) else 'null' end) as id
sql.ricochetWebhook.getContactIdByContactInf: with existing_contact as ( with company_state as ( select (case when :stateAbbreviation is not null then cs.id else null::integer end) id from flow.company_state cs inner join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id where s.abbreviation = :stateAbbreviation and cs.company_id = 3 ) select id from flow.contact where first_name = :firstName and last_name = :lastName and mobile = :mobile and email = :email and street1 = :street1 and city = :city and postal_code = :postalCode and company_state_id = (select id from company_state) and archived is false limit 1 ) select (case when (select id from existing_contact) is not null then (select id::text from existing_contact) else 'null' end) as id
sql.ricochetWebhook.insertLead: with company_state as ( select (case when :stateAbbreviation is not null then cs.id else null::integer end) id from flow.company_state cs inner join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id where s.abbreviation = :stateAbbreviation and cs.company_id = 3 ), company_country as ( select cc.id id from flow.company_country cc where cc.company_id = 3 ), owner as ( select (case when :leadOwnerEmail is not null then up.user_id else 2371412 --Sales Dev Lead's user ID end) user_id, (case when :leadOwnerEmail is not null then up.id else 9016 --Sales Dev Lead's user position ID end) user_position_id from flow.user_position up inner join flow.user u on u.id = up.user_id where u.email = :leadOwnerEmail and up.primary_flag is true ) insert into flow.contact (contact_type_id, first_name, last_name, mobile, email, street1, city, postal_code, created_by_id, company_id, owner_user_position_id, company_state_id, company_country_id) (select 2, :firstName, :lastName, :mobile, :email, :street1, :city, :postalCode, (select user_id from owner), 3, (select user_position_id from owner), (select id from company_state), (select id from company_country)) returning id
sql.ricochetWebhook.updateLead: with company_state as ( select (case when :stateAbbreviation is not null then cs.id else null::integer end) id from flow.company_state cs inner join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id where s.abbreviation = :stateAbbreviation and cs.company_id = 3 ), company_country as ( select cc.id id from flow.company_country cc where cc.company_id = 3 ), owner as ( select (case when :leadOwnerEmail is not null then up.user_id else 2371412 --Sales Dev Lead's user ID end) user_id, (case when :leadOwnerEmail is not null then up.id else 9016 --Sales Dev Lead's user position ID end) user_position_id from flow.user_position up inner join flow.user u on u.id = up.user_id where u.email = :leadOwnerEmail and up.primary_flag is true ) update flow.contact set first_name = :firstName, last_name = :lastName, mobile = :mobile, email = :email, street1 = :street1, city = :city, postal_code = :postalCode, company_state_id = (select id from company_state), date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = (select user_id from owner), owner_user_position_id = (select user_position_id from owner), company_country_id = (select company_country.id from company_country) where id = :contactId returning id
sql.ricochetWebhook.checkIfCustomFieldDropdo: with existing_value as ( select id from flow.list_of_value lov where lov.parent_id = :listOfValueId and lov.name = :customFieldDropdownValue ) select (case when (select id from existing_value) is not null then (select id::text from existing_value) else 'null' end) as id
sql.ricochetWebhook.insertCustomFieldDropdow: with display_order as ( select max(display_order) as value from flow.list_of_value where parent_id = :listOfValueId ), owner as ( select (case when :leadOwnerEmail is not null then up.user_id else 2371412 --Sales Dev Lead's user ID end) user_id from flow.user_position up inner join flow.user u on u.id = up.user_id where u.email = :leadOwnerEmail and up.primary_flag is true ) insert into flow.list_of_value (name, parent_id, display_order, created_by_id) (select :customFieldDropdownValue, :listOfValueId, ((select value from display_order) + 1), (select user_id from owner)) returning id
sql.ricochetWebhook.checkForExistingCustomFi: with existing_row as ( select ccfv.id from flow.contact_custom_field_value ccfv where ccfv.contact_id = :contactId and ccfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id = :customFieldGroupAssignmentId and ccfv.archived is false ) select (case when (select id from existing_row) is not null then (select id::text from existing_row) else 'null' end) as id
sql.ricochetWebhook.insertCustomFieldValue: with owner as ( select (case when :leadOwnerEmail is not null then up.user_id else 2371412 --Sales Dev Lead's user ID end) user_id from flow.user_position up inner join flow.user u on u.id = up.user_id where u.email = :leadOwnerEmail and up.primary_flag is true ) insert into flow.contact_custom_field_value (contact_id, custom_field_group_assignment_id, text_value, int_value, created_by_id) values (:contactId, :customFieldGroupAssignmentId, :textValue, :intValue, (select user_id from owner))
sql.ricochetWebhook.updateCustomFieldValue: with owner as ( select (case when :leadOwnerEmail is not null then up.user_id else 2371412 --Sales Dev Lead's user ID end) user_id from flow.user_position up inner join flow.user u on u.id = up.user_id where u.email = :leadOwnerEmail and up.primary_flag is true ) update flow.contact_custom_field_value set custom_field_group_assignment_id = :customFieldGroupAssignmentId, text_value = :textValue, int_value = :intValue, modified_by_id = (select user_id from owner), date_modified = now() where id = :id
